member.name: M:ClaudeProfileManager.Windows.WindowsClaudeAuthDetector.ConsoleApiKeyRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^sk-ant-api03-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{80,100}$
Options:
RegexOptions.Compiled
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match the string "sk-ant-api03-".
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least 80 and at most 100 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:ClaudeProfileManager.Windows.WindowsClaudeAuthDetector.OAuthTokenRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^\\{.*claudeAiOauth.*\\}$
Options:
RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match '{'.
○ Match any character greedily any number of times.
○ Match the string "claudeAiOauth".
○ Match any character greedily any number of times.
○ Match '}'.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
